normalization_rule: Bootstrap SHALL concatenate the registered normalized requirement records without changing requirement identity, owner, statement, lifecycle state, or C/A applicability.

covered_contract_groups: authority and requirement identity and ownership
proposal registry, seed, projection, and lineage contracts
canonical generation-source registry and deterministic generation
normative requirement atomicity and statement-length discipline
mandatory decomposition of materially compound obligations
design_coverage.rule: Before deriving Conformance assertions or Assurance obligations, every normative bootstrap Design contract used by implementation SHALL resolve to one identified requirement owned by exactly one FS0 authority.
